translation: If the flesh of the wound is hard and does not disperse, this is because it has been attacked by wind. One may add duhuo (獨活), mixed with hot wine and applied; if it still does not disperse, then the wind toxin has already penetrated deeply and the flesh is firm; add purple bark powder (紫荊皮末) and apply together, and there is a principle by which it will surely disperse. <ins>Feng Kou Yao (封口藥)</ins> (see the nasal pillar bone injury)
